shortDescription: German group Bilfinger XETR:GBF on Wednesday lowered for the second time its 2026 outlook, citing weaker than expected performance.It now expects revenue of €5.3 billion ($6.07 billion) to €5.7 billion, down from an earlier forecast of €5.4 billion to €5.9 billion.($1 = 0.8724 euros)
